summary: Thorough backend testing of 4 deferred endpoints completed — all 13 new tests + 31 regression tests = 44/44 PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) POST /api/voice/stt with auth + small generated silent WAV returns 200 with text field; rejects missing file (422), non-audio (500 'Transcription failed'), unauthenticated (401/403), and >25MB upload (400 'too large'). (2) POST /api/resume/parse with on-the-fly reportlab-generated PDF returns 200 with {filename, parsed:{name,skills,education,experience,...}, text_length}; rejects non-PDF (500 'Resume parse failed') and unauth (401/403). (3) POST /api/profile/onboarding persists preparation_stage/previous_attempts/challenges/preferred_language, returns updated user with onboarding_completed=true, no _id/password leakage; persistence re-verified via /auth/me. (4) GET /api/sessions/{id}/report.pdf returns 200 with application/pdf and Content-Disposition attachment; body starts with %PDF- bytes (>1KB); 404 for non-existent session; 401/403 without auth. Razorpay remains MOCKED (expected).

minor.issue: Whisper happy-path with 1s silent WAV returns 200 but Whisper currently transcribes silence to '' (empty string) — acceptable per review spec but worth noting for monitoring real audio behaviour.
5MB hard-cap is documented as 25MB in spec for STT only; resume cap (5MB) is correct but undocumented in API responses — consider returning the limit in the 400 detail.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 927 lines (was 712) — strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, sessions.py, questions.py, subscription.py, voice.py, resume.py, reports.py, onboarding.py, seed.py.

/api/voice/stt has 25MB size check AFTER reading the full file into memory — for large bodies this still consumes RAM; consider checking Content-Length header first or streaming read with early abort.
/api/resume/parse: pypdf failure surfaces as 500 'Resume parse failed' which is semantically a client-side bad input — consider returning 400 for PdfReadError to distinguish from server errors.
/api/profile/onboarding lacks enum validation on preparation_stage and previous_attempts — any string is accepted (e.g., previous_attempts='2' as string was accepted in tests).
PDF report endpoint imports reportlab inside the handler on every call — move imports to module top level for ~50-100ms latency reduction per request.
STT endpoint imports OpenAISpeechToText inside handler on every call — same module-level import improvement opportunity.
Demo seed sessions still have the typo 'voice' if camera_used else 'voice' (no 'voice_camera' branch) — unchanged from previous review.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Ephemeral test artifacts (silent WAV, reportlab PDF) generated in-memory per test. The demo user's profile is now mutated with onboarding fields, resume_parsed_data, and resume_filename — tests are idempotent but state-mutating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 deferred endpoints (voice/stt, resume/parse, profile/onboarding, sessions/{id}/report.pdf) PASS. Combined test suite is now /app/backend/tests/ with two files (test_mitharva_backend.py for original 31, test_deferred_endpoints.py for new 13). Run `pytest backend/tests/ -v` to retest. STT, resume parse, and Gemini calls go through real LLM API key; allow ~5-10s per resume parse. Demo user's plan gets upgraded to 'pro' and onboarding fields are written — re-running tests is safe but observe state mutations. Razorpay is the only remaining MOCKED integration.
